name: Mini-RAG
one_liner: Ask your documents a question and get an answer with the sources.
rows: Upload documents, index them with embeddings, and get streamed answers with numbered citations. When the documents don't support an answer, it says so.
Hybrid search (pgvector + full-text), an MCP server for AI agents, multi-tenant API keys with quotas and audit log, TypeScript and Python SDKs.
Retrieval evaluation suite that runs in CI, alongside pytest, ruff, mypy and Vitest.
stack_text: FastAPI · PostgreSQL + pgvector · Vue 3 · TypeScript · Docker

name: Django LMS
one_liner: A course platform with payments, a social feed and a job board.
rows: Paid courses via Stripe, quizzes and verifiable PDF certificates, a social feed with groups and events, job search with skill matching.
Live chat with typing indicators and read receipts on Django Channels; notifications in-app, by email or as digests; moderation and instructor analytics.
CI with backend pytest, frontend unit tests and Playwright end-to-end journeys; OpenAPI docs.
stack_text: Django · DRF · Channels · Celery · Vue 3 · PostgreSQL · Redis

name: DevTrust
one_liner: Tools I made to check code when AI writes part of it.
rows: Architecture models of a codebase, smart test selection per change, AI-aware PR review that flags invented function calls, LLM tracing and cost attribution.
Python monorepo with GitHub Apps that run test selection and PR review on every pull request.
Published to PyPI with Trusted Publishing; 281 tests, mypy --strict and ruff in CI.
